rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: On 8 May 2008 Medvedev presented Putin's candidacy to the deputies; the item reports that the Duma deputies approved Vladimir Putin as Chairman of the Government by 392 votes to 56, and adds that 448 deputies (100%) took part in the sitting.
